case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (C) Nos. 23633–23634 of 2010) AND CIVIL APPEAL No. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (C) No. 26608 of 2011)

parties.petitioner: Vellore District Environment Monitoring Committee and All India Skin and Hide Tanners and Merchants Association
parties.respondent: The District Collector, Vellore District & Others and Loss of Ecology (Prevention & Compensation Authority) & Others

summary: Key issues: enforcement of compensation for ecological damage caused by tanneries in Vellore; status of pollution in River Palar; liability of polluting industries and state authorities. Standards applied: precautionary principle, polluter pays principle, sustainable development. Reasoning: tannery effluents have severely polluted water and land, violating environmental rights; persistent non-compliance with effluent standards despite prior judicial orders; state failure in enforcement. Outcome: Court upheld liability for compensation, directed implementation of LoEA award, mandated closure of defaulting units, and called for sustainable solutions balancing development and ecology.
legal_provisions_cited: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; directions issued for payment of compensation, closure of non-compliant tanneries, and monitoring of environmental restoration in Vellore district.
